response.courseDescription: 301 Architectural Design III Introduction of architectural design focusing on environmental and social issues. Travel for site visit required.
response.coursePrerequisites: ARCH 203 with C or better; MATH 108 with C or better, or 140, 171, 202, or 206, or a minimum ALEKS math score 75%; 4 cr of PHYSICS 101 with C or better, or PHYSICS 101 and 111 with C or better; admit to the major in Arch Studies.
